note: *voltará à terra* drops *suam*: with *sua* the blind reader heard the native land. The Latinist's major, held at both gates, pending. *voltará à sua terra* is option 1, one touch; MS1932 has *ao seu pó*.
*esmagados* came in draft 3 to copy 144:14 (the elísi row); only the final gate read it. *derrubados* (v1-v2) kept the blow and fall; *abatidos* is familiar but heard as dejected.
*Ele guarda* makes the relative finite; the Latinist asked *Que guarda* in all three runs, held because a relative heading a prayed verse sounds like an exclamation.
*faz juízo para os que sofrem injustiça* copies 102:6. The stylist heard *faz juízo* as behaving sensibly and asked *julga a causa dos*; MS1932 and CNBB say *faz justiça aos*.
